instruction: The text on websites is too small for me to read comfortably. Can you increase the default font size in Chrome to 20?

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome's default font size to 20. Uses existing getter (get_chrome_font_size) and metric (check_font_size) to verify the setting.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing evaluator functions from chrome.py - no custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_chrome_font_size) correctly extracts font size settings from Chrome's Preferences file
Metric (check_font_size) correctly compares default_font_size against the expected value of 20
Expected value structure is correct: metric receives {"type": "value", "value": 20} from get_rule
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure Preferences file is persisted and readable
Evaluator fully covers the instruction requirement to set default font size to 20
